resolved_conflicts.explanation: No real conflict: Forest Lookouts says removed with no date, and firelookout.com says gone prior to 1956. Both fit the FFLA status of Gone.

notes_for_editor: The removal has no date beyond gone prior to 1956, so no removed event was recorded. A 2022 Whitefish Pilot article describes an unnamed 40-foot lookout in a Whitefish yard; it was not used as Standard Peak because the kind and location do not match. The 1922 fire quote on the Forest Lookouts page concerns the Moran and Mt. Stannard stations, not this site, and was not used. Elevation 7,196 ft (about 2,194 m, converted) could fill elevation_m.
